api: REST API and Google Cloud SDK.
cons: Third-party model licences need independent review
name: Google Vertex AI
pros: Gemini family under enterprise GCP controls
End-to-end ML platform in one place
GCP residency and IAM controls for regulated industries
files: Training data, models, and inference payloads in GCP storage formats.
value: Google's unified ML platform for training, deployment, and management, with Gemini and third-party models available under GCP's enterprise controls. The enterprise answer when the organization is already on GCP and needs both the Gemini family and ML platform capabilities in one place.
engine: Gemini model family plus third-party and open-source models available through Model Garden.
latency: Comparable to other cloud model endpoints.
quality: Gemini models under GCP controls. Same quality characteristics, different data terms.
tagline: Google's enterprise AI platform: model deployment, MLOps, and Gemini under GCP controls.
use_cases: Deploying and managing ML and generative AI at enterprise scale under GCP
Accessing Gemini models with GCP's IAM, VNET, and residency controls
Building end-to-end ML pipelines with managed training, evaluation, and serving
integrations: Full GCP ecosystem: BigQuery, Cloud Storage, IAM, VNET
Vertex AI Workbench, Pipelines, and Feature Store
Same Gemini API surface as the developer product
governance_note: Same data-path logic as Azure OpenAI: enterprise controls convert a consumer data-handling question into an enterprise compliance question. Residency and VNET are the controls to confirm. Model Garden also surfaces third-party and open-source models with their own licences, so licence review applies to those selections even though they are accessed through a managed platform.
training_optout: GCP enterprise terms: customer data is not used to train Google's models. Verify via the GCP Data Processing Amendment.
